_comments.id: URL-safe slug; also the content sub-folder name AND the audio folder inside the shared R2 bucket (content/<id>/<ep>/, and key <id>/<ep>/<voice>.m4a).
_comments.groupNames: Map every module CODE used in episode folder names (e.g. M1, PF11) to its human title. CASE is the synthetic case-studies module.
_comments.yearMap: Which HSC year each module code belongs to, for the Year 11 / Year 12 split. CASE spans both. Unlisted codes fall under 'Other'.
_comments.audioBaseUrl: Public origin of the ONE shared audio bucket (same for every subject), e.g. https://audio.hsc.pebnum.com. The manifest builder appends /<id>/<ep>/<voice>.m4a, so each subject is a folder in that bucket. Use 'content' to serve audio from the repo during local dev.
_comments.remove: Delete this _comments block once the file is filled in.
